items.title: Atlantic/WMG Sues Ray-Ban Owner Luxottica, Demands Over $64 Million in Damages as Social Media Infringement Crackdown Continues
items.summary: The social media copyright crackdown continues: Warner Music Group (WMG) is now suing multiple subsidiaries of eyewear giant EssilorLuxottica for allegedly infringing on north of 400 compositions and recordings in Instagram and TikTok posts. Plaintiffs including Atlantic Music Group and Warner Chappell recently submitt…

items.title: Can We Sue Our Way to AI Control?
items.summary: The labels want their power back. Copyright needs to be rebuilt. There is a comforting version of the AI music story in which the record labels sue, the technology companies pay, and musicians emerge with their rights intact. The lawyers finish arguing, the executives shake hands, and somebody issues a statement about…

items.title: Italian Competition Watchdog Launches Suno Investigation ‘Over Unfair Terms,’ Says ‘The Contractual Provisions on Copyright Deserve Particular Attention’
items.summary: When it rains, it pours and, in Suno’s case, keeps on pouring: Besides facing a number of stateside lawsuits as well as international copyright claims, the AI music generator is now grappling with a formal investigation in Italy over its allegedly “unfair terms.” The Italian Competition Authority (ICA) disclosed the pr…

items.title: La legislación sobre derechos de autor tiene dificultades para adaptarse a la música creada con inteligencia artificial en Corea del Sur.
RIAA Flags Anna’s Archive and AI Voice Cloner to U.S. Government
items.summary: The RIAA has submitted its latest overview of "notorious markets" to the U.S. Government. It lists familiar names such as The Pirate Bay and Rapidgator, but the music group also flags shadow library Anna's Archive and AI voice-cloning service Lalals. The RIAA presents both as "additional" areas of concern, not as offic…

items.title: Universal Music appoints first AI director amid copyright lawsuits
Deezer permitirá ocultar la música hecha con IA al buscar
items.summary: Deezer permitirá a sus usuarios ocultar la música generada íntegramente con inteligencia artificial. La plataforma francesa ha anunciado un interruptor que, una vez activado, excluirá de los resultados de búsqueda las canciones, los álbumes y los artistas vinculados a contenido 100% sintético. La función llegará a todo…

items.title: YouTube Music etiqueta la música generada con IA
items.summary: YouTube Music ha empezado a etiquetar las canciones creadas «principalmente con inteligencia artificial generativa». La etiqueta aparece en la pantalla del reproductor y, al pulsarla, se abre un menú con más información. La función se amplía también a la aplicación principal de YouTube, según anunció la plataforma el 1…

items.title: Warner Chappell Music signs My Chemical Romance to exclusive worldwide publishing deal
items.summary: Warner Chappell will oversee the catalog's global rights administration, copyright protection, and sync licensing across film, television, and video games. Source

items.title: UK Copyright Tribunal ruling recognises “increased value of music in cinema” says PRS
items.summary: A dispute over what royalties cinemas should pay PRS for music contained in the films they screen went before the UK Copyright Tribunal earlier this year. It has ruled in favour of a higher royalty rate which, PRS says, “recognises the increased value of music in the overall cinema experience”

items.title: La industria musical australiana advierte al Parlamento contra la flexibilización de las leyes de derechos de autor para permitir el uso de la inteligencia artificial.
Sara Landry’s legal battle with ex-managers over commissions, copyrights and trademarks now being fought out in US and UK
items.summary: In August, London-based management firm The Night Department sued techno producer Sara Landry for breach of contract. She has now responded and countersued. The core dispute is over the management company’s involvement in her label, though there’s also some griping over a Coachella pissing incident

tip.title: Registra tu catálogo también en la sociedad de gestión
tip.body: El registro de autoría y la recaudación son trámites distintos. Si tu obra no está dada de alta en la sociedad correspondiente, las regalías de ejecución pública simplemente no te llegan.

tip.title: Register with your collecting society too
tip.body: Copyright registration and royalty collection are separate steps. If your work isn't registered with the right society, public performance royalties simply never reach you.
